text.en:
Weapon Kills with a Matching Subclass Element grant a buff, depending on whether your Super Ability is charged or not.

If Super is not Full:
Energy Siphon for 2 seconds. (Essentially a Cooldown)
Energy Siphon grants <pve 3% /> <pvp [+1.45%] /> Super Energy.

If Super is Full:
Grants Absorption Cells, granting <pve 20% /> <pvp [15%] /> increased damage for Weapons Matching your Subclass Element for <pve 6 /> <pvp [3.5] /> seconds. Additional Kills increase duration by <pve 4 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds.
Absorption Cells maxes out at a <pve 10 /> <pvp [6] /> second duration.

Absorption Cells disappears on Weapon Swap.
